correctness.rationale: The folded nine-cube is X=F₂^9/<all-ones> with 256 cosets, distance d=min(Hamming distance,9−Hamming distance). Even-weight Walsh characters descend to all 256 characters; their nontrivial weights 2,4,6,8 have multiplicities 36,126,84,9. Direct Krawtchouk summation yields λ2=5+8·2^p−14·4^p, λ4=1−4·2^p−4·3^p+6·4^p, λ6=−3+8·3^p−6·4^p, λ8=−7+20·2^p−28·3^p+14·4^p. There is no antipodal-shell doubling factor. In a=2^p, α=log₂3, λ8=14a²−28a^α+20a−7 strictly increases for a≥1 (positive derivative at 1, positive second derivative using α<8/5); it uniquely vanishes at p*=0.323267128142707..., below 1/3 by exact rational cubing bounds. Rational inequalities keep the three other nonconstant multipliers strictly negative on (0,1/3]. Thus d^p is conditionally negative exactly 0<p≤p*. The centered Euclidean Gram loses only the multiplicity-nine weight-eight sector at the endpoint, so dimensions are 255 below and 246 at p*. Squared Euclidean embedding/Schoenberg gives positive definiteness of e^(−td^p) for every t>0 exactly on that interval; a positive Walsh eigenvalue gives a small-t counterexample above. Independent 256-coset Walsh/Krawtchouk reconstruction checked the exact eigenvalue vectors, root and dimensions.
